QuestInfo.name: [Black Wings] Nothing is More Important Than Money
QuestInfo.1:
#p2153000# was a resident of #m310000000#, but became a Black Wing watchman for money. On top of that, #p2153000# earns extra money by selling the batteries inside #r#o3150000##k... Find some batteries for #p2153000#.

#i4032764# #t4032764# #b#c4032764#/40#k
QuestInfo.2: When you gave #p2153000# the #t4032764#, he laughed villainously. You hope #p2153000# has a good explanation for that...

0.0: The most important thing in this world is money. That's why I became a Black Wing, even though it meant betraying the town where I was born and raised. Hehe... I don't really care what anyone says or thinks about me.
0.1: This town's economy depends on #bRue#k, since it's so valuable. The price for Rue has been steadily increasing every since the Black Wings took control of the mine. It's the perfect time to make a lot of dough. So, you in?

yes.0: You know those #r#o3150000# Signs#k around here? Hunt them and bring back their batteries. Even though those batteries are small, not all of the Rue inside has been consumed so they can be worth quite a bit, especially if you collect a lot.
yes.1: So go hunt the #o3150000# Signs and bring back some #bRue Batteries#k... About #b40#k should do. I'll pay you a good price for them... And don't even think about running of with them. You don't know who to sell them to.

no.0: What, are you one of those goodie two shoes? How are you gonna make money like that?

1.0: You have the Rue Batteries? Let's see. Okay, I'll pay you for them, minus the transaction fees, of course.

yes.0: I don't care what people say. I'm going to keep doing this and I'm going to keep making money. Once I have enough to reach my goal, then... Never mind. Pretend you didn't hear that.

item.0: You haven't brought 40 #t4032764#s yet. All you have to do is hunt the #r#o3150000#s#k and bring back their #b#t4032764#s#k. It's simple!
